title: Obsidian context configuration
description: Copy to .agents/obsidian-context.json and customize per project.

notes.vault.name: Exact name from: obsidian vaults verbose
notes.vault.path: Optional absolute path; used to verify vault.name
notes.basePath: Root folder inside vault for this project's notes
notes.sessionLogsPath: Optional override for session logs (e.g. Logs). Default: {basePath}/logs
